name: YouTube Keyword Research
scope: Live sample phrase evidence, filters and CSV. Private index and demand/difficulty formulas are not replicated.

name: YouTube Tag Extractor
scope: Public video tags, correct API-style character count, copy and TXT export.

name: Video Rank Checker
scope: Automatic title/tag keywords or manual five-keyword ranking. Up to 50 API results; signed-in top-200/channel-handle mode not implemented.

name: Video SEO Checker
scope: Metadata heuristics, target-keyword and chapter checks. Scoring weights are ClickLab-specific.

name: Hashtag Generator
scope: AI brief, requested count and local hashtag check. AI formatting/relevance still needs review.

name: Trending Keywords
scope: Two live search samples of up to 50 each, not global historical index trends.

name: Niche Finder
scope: Live sample and phrase evidence. Historical growth, index-wide opportunity and faceless classifications unavailable.

name: Title Generator
scope: AI drafts and 12 local formula directions; public video evidence can be attached. Dedicated 3-title shortlist workflow not implemented.

name: Title Analyzer
scope: Three-title checks, target phrase, imported title and approximate truncation. Proprietary winning-pattern analysis not replicated.

name: Tags Generator
scope: AI tag list with official-style character count. Intent groups and interactive tag editor not implemented.

name: Description & Metadata Generator
scope: AI brief, source-description import and local template. Structured five-title packaging dashboard not replicated.

name: Channel Description Generator
scope: AI About drafts and existing-description import. Separate scored About audit and link-title editor not implemented.

name: Thumbnail & Title Tester
scope: Three local variants, optional real competitor sample and grayscale. No CTR forecast; dedicated device-layout switch not implemented.

name: Thumbnail Size Checker
scope: Batch dimensions, format, shape and file-size checks. Duration-badge overlay and small-feed previews not implemented.

name: Thumbnail Downloader
scope: Available video thumbnail sizes and original links. Channel thumbnail gallery/direct file download not implemented.

name: Image Resizer (thumbnail, banner, PFP)
scope: Eight size presets, crop anchors, contain, JPEG/PNG/WebP, measured output-size constraint. Blurred background not implemented.

name: Banner Template & Checker
scope: Safe-area overlay and dark/transparent standalone SVG templates. All device preview modes not replicated.

name: Profile Picture & Banner Downloader
scope: API artwork URLs. Original-size reconstruction and direct file downloads not implemented.

name: Channel Audit
scope: Five explicit checks, priority fixes, recent cadence, views and engagement. No universal growth score or verified monetization.

name: Engagement Rate Calculator
scope: Manual or real video/channel counts; weighted engagement with missing-count coverage. Matched-category benchmark not implemented.

name: Channel Comparison
scope: Two to four live channel profiles with sample views, cadence and engagement. Confirmed Shorts share unavailable.

name: Channel Valuation
scope: User profit and editable low/high multiples. Automatic broker-factor adjustments and acquisition memo not implemented.

name: Subscriber Count Checker
scope: Rounded public count/range and optional 2-minute refresh; persistent history available in Real Time. Pre-tracking history unavailable.

name: Monetization Requirements Checker
scope: Import public subscribers; current/future ad-entry and expanded-program numeric checks. Owner watch hours, policy/country eligibility and actual monetization cannot be verified.

name: Channel Age Finder
scope: Bulk creation timestamp lookup, up to 10 channels. Calendar-age breakdown and per-year averages not yet shown in bulk mode.

name: Channel ID Finder
scope: Bulk IDs, handles, dates and uploads-playlist IDs, up to 10. Copy/export is generic JSON, not dedicated CSV.

name: Channel Name Generator
scope: AI names with brief and manual batch live-handle checking. No guaranteed claimability or persistent repeat-name exclusion.

name: Subscribe Link Generator
scope: Permanent-ID subscribe URL and official website button markup.

name: Name Checker
scope: Seven candidate public-handle lookups. No API match does not prove registration availability; no proprietary brand score.

name: Similar Channel Finder
scope: Live search candidates with size filters. Private similarity index and faceless/format filters unavailable.

name: Shorts Outlier Finder
scope: Confirmed Shorts listings, own-channel baselines, returned-result filters. At most 10 channels/search and 30 Shorts/channel; private index unavailable.

name: YouTube Outlier Finder
scope: Own-channel sampled baselines, date/duration/sort/sample filters. Duration groups are not confirmed Shorts; no global index.

name: YouTube Outlier Calculator
scope: Manual baseline or fetched recent-upload comparison excluding target. Duration grouping and unequal ages limit comparison.

name: YouTube Transcript & Subtitles
scope: Available subtitles; search/TXT and SRT from preserved fetched cues or pasted SRT/VTT. Old plain-text cache lacks timing; no extension-based translation.

name: Video Stats
scope: Public counts, tags, duration, category, language and lifetime velocity. Paid-promotion/made-for-kids flags and video historical index not implemented.

name: Comment Picker
scope: Paged comments, filters, unique known authors, owner exclusion, dates, likes, winners/backups and draw record. Tagged-friend rule not implemented; only loaded eligible pool.

name: Comment Reply Writer
scope: Paste comments or load confirmed-unanswered comments, then generate drafts. Partial reply sets remain unknown; never posts replies.

name: Video ID Extractor
scope: Bulk standard YouTube links/IDs and CSV. Attribution links, classification and availability-check workflow not implemented.

name: Embed Code Generator
scope: Video/playlist, responsive/fixed/vertical, start/end, autoplay-muted, loop, captions and privacy host. Remaining player switches not implemented.

name: Playlist Length Calculator
scope: Up to 500 entries, speed totals, available-entry subset and running totals. Private/deleted positions shift; complete arbitrary-size playlists not supported.

name: Timestamp Link Generator
scope: Flexible time input, multiple moments, short/watch links and Markdown data. Playlist preservation/embed moment variants not implemented.

name: Chapters Generator
scope: AI draft or local validation of provided timing. Last chapter needs duration. Automatic timing corrections are deliberately not invented.

name: Title and Description Translator
scope: AI translation from supplied material and target languages. Dedicated six-language structured output controls not implemented.

name: Trending Videos
scope: Country code/category chart and sample date/duration/sort filters. Lifetime views/hour is not measured hourly velocity.

name: Comment Finder
scope: Server searchTerms, paging, local question/timestamp/reply filters, sorts and CSV. Returned replies may be incomplete; whole-video completeness not claimed.

name: Video Summarizer
scope: Available transcript or pasted text to AI overview. Factual review required; extension-specific language workflow unavailable.

name: Frame by Frame Player
scope: YouTube native pause/comma/period frame stepping. No custom frame-accurate control/timecode export.

name: YouTube API Quota Calculator
scope: Itemized endpoint costs, separate search/upload buckets, tracking estimate and remaining quota. Actual project limits must be checked in Cloud Console.

name: YouTube Pay Per View
scope: User RPM or attributed published niche/country presets. Scenario estimates, not actual earnings.

name: YouTube Money Calculator
scope: Separate long-form/Shorts assumptions, goal math and saved scenarios; optional attributed RPM presets. No earnings measurement.

name: Sponsorship Rate Calculator
scope: Public-view import, user CPM range, rights/exclusivity/production add-ons. Lifetime sample is not verified first-30-day performance; format rate-card/memo not implemented.

name: Best Time to Post
scope: Channel-sample weekday/hour evidence in chosen timezone. Private niche-wide breakout heatmap unavailable; not viewer-online data.

name: RPM by Niche & Country
scope: User scenarios plus 127 published niche entries, 27 country factors and strict 100% blended audience. Third-party estimates, not YouTube official rates.

name: Niche Score Checker
scope: Evidence-only live sample. Proprietary opportunity score, historical concentration/growth and verified faceless data unavailable.

name: Watch Time Calculator
scope: User-input pace, target and assumed monthly expiry. Rolling-cohort exact expiry and automated threshold-deadline planner not implemented.

name: RPM & CPM Calculator
scope: Measured-input RPM/CPM, optional monetized-playback rate and goal math. Does not infer advertiser CPM from a guessed revenue share.

name: RPM by Niche Comparison
scope: User multi-niche rows and published preset insertion. No proprietary ranking; comparison is scenario arithmetic.

name: YouTube Take-Home Calculator
scope: User gross/expenses/reserve rate. Multi-deduction source/date ledger and low/high month scenarios not implemented.

name: AdSense Payout Checklist
scope: Local self-reported setup checklist. Does not access AdSense or verify payout/account status.

name: Income Mix Calculator
scope: Seven sources, proportions, concentration and largest-source-halving stress test.

name: Video Ideas Generator
scope: AI briefs with optional attached live video evidence. Attached videos are not automatically certified breakouts.

name: Hook Generator
scope: AI briefing plus ten local templates and word/runtime estimate. Dedicated hook quality/visual-cue dashboard not implemented.

name: Script Review
scope: AI review with title/audience/context and speaking-rate assumptions. AI judgments are not verified retention forecasts.

name: Script Generator
scope: AI script or local timed outline, format/audience/voice brief and word/runtime estimates. Timings remain assumptions.

name: Faceless Niche Finder
scope: Candidate topic research. No private faceless classifier/index; video format requires manual verification.

name: Topic Research
scope: Live topic/phrase/source evidence and attach-to-brief workflow. Outside-YouTube web research and unified AI report not implemented.
